tex_content.html:
Let $\bar t$ be a surgery time with no earlier surgery in $(\bar t-\tau _1,\bar t)$. Flow backward the neck portions $J_0(\bar t)=\coprod _i s_{N_i}^{-1}(-25,0]$ adjacent to its surgery spheres, and write $J_0(t)$ for their images. If $D_t$ is the region disappearing at $\bar t$, set $J(t)=J_0(t)\cup D_t$ and $J(\bar t-\tau _1,\bar t)=\bigcup _{t\in (\bar t-\tau _1,\bar t)}J(t)$.

Lemma
[Paths of bounded kinetic energy avoid the disappearing region]
